study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Holz NE et al., Psychological Medicine, 2023

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Multicenter cohort from the EU-funded Aggressotype and MATRICS consortia, involving nine sites in Europe.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Participants in the current study were part of the EU-funded Aggressotype and MATRICS projects.

answer.Aggressotype and MATRICS: normative training and testing for functional and structural models; patient for clinical research (DBD) vs control

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Data used to train Gaussian process regression (GPR) models for brain function (activity during emotion matching task) and structure (Jacobian determinants), and to compare deviations in DBD cases and healthy controls.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: First, normative modeling to map deviations from the typical age-related pattern at the level of the individual of (i) activity during emotion matching and (ii) of anatomical images derived from DBD cases (n = 77) and controls (n = 52) aged 8 -18 years from the EU-funded Aggressotype and MATRICS consortia.

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Model-1 (functional) included 52 healthy controls (out of 129 total participants used for the reference cohort). Model-2 (structural) included 50 healthy controls (out of 127 total participants, after 2 exclusions from the 129 sample). Both models were trained using 10-fold cross-validation on the whole cohort (TD + DBD).
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Holz2023.pdf.md: Method / Study sample, Method / Anatomical images, Method / Constructing normative models of brain structure and function
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: anatomical images ... N = 248 (154 cases, 94 controls) ... Out of this sample, n = 129 had both functional and structural data available. Two scans had to be excluded ... leaving a final sample of 127 participants. ... we used the whole cohort (both TD and DBD) as a reference ... GPR predictions are derived in an unbiased manner under 10-fold cross-validation.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: For the functional model (N=129), the included sample age mean was 13.64 (SD 2.53) years. The age range was 8-18 years. The structural model (N=127) was derived from the same sample with two exclusions, so age characteristics are inferred to be nearly identical.

The female N (31) and percentage (24%) are derived by summing the controls (18 females, calculated from 52 total and 34 males) and cases (13 females, calculated from 77 total and 64 males) provided in Table 1.
